Our practice

Meet Dr. Aaron Kahen

Dr. Kahen received his Doctor of Dental Surgery from USC’s Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry and has been caring for Sherman Oaks patients since 2012. His approach is simple: thorough, honest, and unhurried. He explains every step before he takes it — and asks how you’re doing throughout.

Patients describe him as the dentist who finally made them not dread the dentist. His team — including office manager Tina and hygienist Alan — have been with him long enough that new patients feel like returning ones.
